records.title: Aşk-ı Memnu
records.subtitle: Forbidden Love · Bihter / Adnan arc
records.meta: TV series · Turkey · Turkish (Kanal D) · English: Forbidden Love
records.mechanism: Age-gap marriage — young adult wife, older / rich husband
records.summary: Young Bihter marries the wealthy, much older widower Adnan Ziyagil, stepmother to his children Nihal and Bülent, then begins an affair with his nephew Behlül. records.pregnancy_note: by her husband Adnan as presented (eps. 67–70); she ends the pregnancy without telling him
records.kids_note: none before the marriage (Adnan's two children are her stepchildren)
